checks.name: required_files
checks.basis: lexical SQLite, Chroma SQLite and cache manifest

checks.name: schema
checks.basis: required pages columns and FTS5 table/columns

checks.name: page_identity_versions
checks.basis: pages primary key, payload identity and document/version/source cardinality

checks.name: fts_pages
checks.basis: FTS page_id set, multiplicity and stored indexed fields versus payload

checks.name: chroma_pages
checks.basis: paginated Chroma IDs and metadata versus SQLite pages

checks.name: zip_identity
checks.basis: cache_documents recorded ZIP paths/hashes/source keys and indexed document IDs
findings: entries=0, collision_keys=0, cross_conflicts=0, incomplete=0, completed_missing_index=0, duplicate_hash_sources=0

checks.name: version_attestation
checks.basis: caller-supplied human attestation; authenticity not independently verified
findings: explicit document/version and ZIP inventory attestation matches

unable_to_check: Chroma PersistentClient may modify the disposable copy; this is not a strictly read-only client.
Vector contents, ANN quality, FTS index internals, source authenticity and snapshot quiescence are not proven.
ZIP collisions are limited to cache manifest entries; unrecorded archives and original source identity are not independently checked.
Existing indexes have no authoritative active-version registry; hashes and scores do not establish the current version.
Attestation is a caller declaration; independent authority, ZIP scope and real-world source identity cannot be verified by this tool.
